back: The process of identifying, anticipating and satisfying customers' needs profitably.
Identify needs, satisfy needs, maintain loyalty, build relationships, anticipate changes in needs.
Belief that customers want cheap, available products: focus on large, low-cost output.
Belief that customers want the best quality and features: focus on improving the product.
Belief that customers must be persuaded: focus on advertising and sales techniques.
Find out what customers want first, then satisfy those needs better than competitors.
Market orientated: research customers first. Product orientated: make the product, then find customers.

front: Why follow the marketing concept today?
back: Strong competition, informed customers, fast-changing tastes, value of loyal customers.
